nodes.title: Cognitive OS — MODEL_ROUTING.md
nodes.summary: Research profile for choosing model role/family, reasoning effort, strategy, context, tools, verifier, privacy, latency and budget as one execution route.
nodes.why_read: Open for the intended adaptive routing dimensions and failure-recovery options; verify actual runtime wiring elsewhere before claiming activation.

nodes.title: Cognitive OS — ANTI_DEGRADATION.md
nodes.summary: Research surface for containing context rot, goal drift, agent loops, model-update regressions and other degradation modes in long-running AI work.
nodes.why_read: Open when investigating long-horizon degradation and containment strategies; proposed safeguards are not proof they are wired or effective in production.

nodes.title: Cognitive OS — EVIDENCE_USE_CONTRACT.md
nodes.summary: Evidence-use contract constraining how retrieved information, verification outputs and model conclusions may support downstream claims.
nodes.why_read: Open when a Cognitive OS output uses sources or verifier results; evidence handling must remain distinct from model confidence and authority.
